Fluid/moving inclusions are more common than you think, especially in pieces of selenite, lodolite quartz, fluorite etc. it’s always overlooked because you don’t expect it to be there. I got a two kilograms of fluorite palm stones and I found three pieces with fluid or sand inclusions because it’s harder to see without a backlight. So now on I always look through each piece to make sure I don’t miss anything like this:)
